sections.title: Question words — a White Shark fact file
sections.titleUz: So'roq so'zlari — Oq akula haqida ma'lumot

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct question words from the list. Some of them can be used more than once. Then, match the questions to the answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan to'g'ri so'roq so'zlarini qo'ying. Ba'zilari bir necha marta ishlatilishi mumkin. So'ng savollarni javoblarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: How much, Where, What, How long, How

DIQQAT — BA'ZI SO'ZLAR BIR NECHA MARTA ISHLATILADI:
  'What' bu mashqda UCH MARTA kerak bo'ladi.

JAVOBLAR:
  a  All kinds of fish.
  b  Sharp teeth and pointed fins.
  c  1200 kilos.
  d  A White Shark.
  e  30-40 years.
  f  In tropical and warm seas.
  g  3-6 metres.

DIQQAT — 6 va 7 SAVOLNI SOLISHTIRING:
  '...... long IS it?'        → HOW long (uzunlik: metr)
  '...... does it live FOR?'  → HOW LONG (umr: yil)
  6-savolda 'long' ALLAQACHON yozilgan → faqat HOW qo'shiladi.
  7-savolda bo'sh joyga butun 'How long' yoziladi.

items.whyUz:
Hayvon nomi so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
Javob: d — A White Shark (oq akula).

Joy so'ralmoqda → WHERE.
Javob: f — In tropical and warm seas (tropik va iliq dengizlarda).

Ovqat so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
Javob: a — All kinds of fish (har xil baliqlar).

Tana qismlari so'ralmoqda → WHAT.
'has it got' bilan 'does' KERAK EMAS.
Javob: b — Sharp teeth and pointed fins (o'tkir tishlar va uchli suzgichlar).

Og'irlik so'ralmoqda → HOW MUCH.
Javob: c — 1200 kilos.

'long' allaqachon bor → faqat HOW qo'shiladi: How long IS it? (uzunlik).
Javob: g — 3-6 metres.

Umr so'ralmoqda → HOW LONG.
'live FOR' — 'for' davomiylikni bildiradi.
Javob: e — 30-40 years.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, match the questions to the answers.
exercises.explanationUz:
OQ AKULA (A White Shark) HAQIDA FAKTLAR:
  • tropik va iliq dengizlarda yashaydi
  • har xil baliq yeydi
  • o'tkir tishlari va uchli suzgichlari bor
  • taxminan 1200 kilo keladi
  • 3–6 metr uzunlikda
  • 30–40 yil yashaydi

pairs.right: f  In tropical and warm seas.

pairs.whyUz: 'all kinds of' = har xil, barcha turdagi.

pairs.right: b  Sharp teeth and pointed fins.
pairs.whyUz:
'teeth' — 'tooth' ning noto'g'ri ko'pligi.
'pointed' = uchli, o'tkir uchli.

pairs.left: 7  How long does it live for?
pairs.whyUz: Bu yerda 'How long' DAVOMIYLIK ma'nosida — 'for' shuni ko'rsatadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences below about green turtles and make questions for the statements.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi yashil toshbaqalar haqidagi gaplarni o'qing va ularga savol tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBDAN SAVOL TUZISH TARTIBI:
  1) Javobning QAYSI qismi yangi ma'lumot — shuni aniqlang
  2) O'sha qismga mos so'roq so'zini tanlang
  3) DO/DOES qo'shing (agar 'be'/'have got'/'can' bo'lmasa)

MISOL:
  'They eat fish and plants.'
   yangi ma'lumot = 'fish and plants' (ovqat) → WHAT
   savol: What do they eat?

'a green turtle' = yashil toshbaqa (dengiz toshbaqasi)

items.answer: Green turtles live in warm oceans.
items.question: Where do green turtles live?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — JOY ('in warm oceans') → WHERE.
Ko'plik ega → DO.

items.answer: They have got a shell to protect them.
items.question: What have they got?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — TANA QISMI ('a shell') → WHAT.
'have got' bilan 'do' KERAK EMAS.
'a shell' = qobiq; 'to protect' = himoya qilmoq.

items.question: What do they eat?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — OVQAT → WHAT. Ko'plik ega → DO.
'a plant' = o'simlik.

items.question: How much do they weigh?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — OG'IRLIK → HOW MUCH.
DIQQAT: 'weigh' bilan 'be' ishlatilmaydi — 'do they weigh'.

items.answer: They lay about 100 eggs at a time.
items.question: How many eggs do they lay at a time?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — SON ('100 eggs') → HOW MANY (tuxum sanaladi).
'at a time' = bir martada, bir yo'la.

items.question: How long do they live for?
items.whyUz:
Yangi ma'lumot — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.
'for' savolda ham qoladi: 'How long do they live FOR?'

exercises.explanationUz:
PLAKAT SARLAVHASI:
  GREY SEALS NEED YOU — Kulrang tyulenlarga siz keraksiz
  Learn about them and save them — Ular haqida bilib oling va
                                    ularni saqlab qoling

Bu — TABIATNI MUHOFAZA QILISH plakati.
Oxirida: 'TO FIND OUT MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU CAN DO TO SAVE
THEM CALL 911 7063'
  = Ularni saqlab qolish uchun nima qila olishingizni bilmoqchi
    bo'lsangiz, 911 7063 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.en: These lovely mammals live in the north-east and north-west parts of the Atlantic and in the Baltic sea.
sentences.uz: Bu yoqimli sutemizuvchilar Atlantikaning shimoli-sharqiy va shimoli-g'arbiy qismlarida hamda Boltiq dengizida yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz:
'lovely' = yoqimli, chiroyli.
Yo'nalishlar: north-east (shimoli-sharq), north-west (shimoli-g'arb).
'the Atlantic', 'the Baltic sea' — dengiz/okean nomlari THE bilan.

sentences.en: They are great swimmers and can swim very fast.
sentences.uz: Ular ajoyib suzuvchilar va juda tez suza oladi.

sentences.en: They are also excellent divers and can stay underwater for about 15 minutes.
sentences.uz: Ular yana zo'r sho'ng'uvchilar va suv ostida taxminan 15 daqiqa tura oladi.
sentences.noteUz:
'a diver' = sho'ng'uvchi (dive + -r).
'excellent' = a'lo, zo'r. 'underwater' = suv ostida.
'stay FOR + vaqt' — 'for' shart.

sentences.en: Grey seals have got big eyes to help them see well in dark waters, as well as long whiskers and thick grey fur to keep them warm in cold seas.
sentences.uz: Kulrang tyulenlarning qorong'i suvlarda yaxshi ko'rish uchun katta ko'zlari, shuningdek uzun mo'ylovlari va sovuq dengizlarda issiq saqlash uchun qalin kulrang juni bor.
sentences.noteUz:
'as well as' = shuningdek, va yana.
'to help them see' — 'help somebody DO' ('to' YO'Q).
'keep them warm' — Coursebook 40-betdagi pingvin matnidagi ibora.

sentences.en: They eat various kinds of fish and they spend most of their time in the sea.
sentences.uz: Ular har xil baliqlarni yeydi va vaqtining ko'pini dengizda o'tkazadi.
sentences.noteUz:
'various kinds of' = har xil turdagi.
'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq. 'most of' = ko'p qismi.

sentences.en: When they are not in the water, they like to rest and dry their coat on rocky islands or sandy beaches.
sentences.uz: Suvda bo'lmaganda, ular toshli orollarda yoki qumli plyajlarda dam olishni va terisini quritishni yoqtiradi.
sentences.noteUz:
'to rest' = dam olmoq; 'to dry' = quritmoq.
'a coat' bu yerda = hayvonning juni/terisi.
'rocky' = toshli (rock + -y), 'sandy' = qumli (sand + -y).

sentences.en: Grey seals live for about 25 to 30 years.
To find out more about what you can do to save them call 911 7063.
sentences.uz: Ularni saqlab qolish uchun nima qila olishingizni bilish uchun 911 7063 raqamiga qo'ng'iroq qiling.
sentences.noteUz:
'to find out' = bilib olmoq, aniqlamoq.
'to save' = saqlab qolmoq, qutqarmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Then put the words in the sentences that follow in the correct order, to form questions. Finally, answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng quyidagi so'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtirib savol tuzing. Nihoyat, savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TARTIBI:
  So'roq so'zi + yordamchi fe'l (do/does/is/are/have) + ega + fe'l?

MISOL:
  'grey seals / are / what?'
  → What ARE grey seals?
    (so'roq so'zi → 'be' → ega)

  'where / live / they / do?'
  → Where DO they LIVE?
    (so'roq so'zi → do → ega → fe'l)

DIQQAT: 'have got' bilan savol:
  → What HAVE they GOT?  ('do' KERAK EMAS)

items.whyUz:
'be' fe'li so'roq so'zidan keyin, egadan oldin turadi.
JAVOB: They are (lovely) mammals.

So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
JAVOB: They live in the north-east and north-west parts of the Atlantic and in the Baltic sea.

'can' yordamchi fe'l — 'do' KERAK EMAS.
Oxirgi 'do' — asosiy fe'l ('qilmoq').
JAVOB: They can swim very fast and they can stay underwater for about 15 minutes.

'have got' bilan 'do' KERAK EMAS: What HAVE they GOT?
JAVOB: They have got big eyes, long whiskers and thick grey fur.

items.answer: Why have they got big eyes?
items.whyUz:
'Why' + have + ega + got + ot?
JAVOB: To help them see well in dark waters.
(Sabab javobida 'To ...' yoki 'Because ...' ishlatiladi.)

Og'irlik → HOW MUCH + DO + ega + weigh?
JAVOB: They weigh from 150 to 230 kilos.

So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
JAVOB: They eat various kinds of fish.

items.answer: How long do they live for?
items.whyUz:
'How long' + DO + ega + live FOR?
'for' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
JAVOB: They live for about 25 to 30 years.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues below. Which dialogues are positive? Which are negative? Now, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qisqa dialoglarni o'qing. Qaysi dialoglar ijobiy? Qaysilari salbiy? Endi berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA:

  1) IJOBIY (positive):
     A: Do you like dogs?
     B: Yes, I love dogs. They're very friendly animals.

  2) SALBIY (negative):
     A: Do you like snakes?
     B: No, I hate snakes. I think they're very dangerous.

IKKI QOLIP:
  IJOBIY:  Yes, I love ... . They're very + sifat + animals.
  SALBIY:  No, I hate ... . I think they're very + sifat.

BERILGAN SO'ZLAR:
  dolphins - intelligent (delfin — aqlli)
  cats - lazy            (mushuk — dangasa)
  horses - clever        (ot — aqlli)
  lions - scary          (sher — qo'rqinchli)

SIFAT IJOBIYMI YOKI SALBIYMI — SHUNGA QARAB QOLIP TANLANADI:
  intelligent, clever → IJOBIY
  lazy, scary         → SALBIY

items.question: Do you like dogs?
items.answer: Yes, I love dogs. They're very friendly animals.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Bu IJOBIY dialog.

items.question: Do you like snakes?
items.answer: No, I hate snakes. I think they're very dangerous.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. Bu SALBIY dialog.

items.question: Do you like dolphins?
items.answer: Yes, I love dolphins. They're very intelligent animals.
items.whyUz:
'intelligent' (aqlli) — IJOBIY sifat → ijobiy qolip.
Coursebook 40-betda: 'Dolphins are very intelligent animals.'

items.question: Do you like cats?
items.answer: No, I hate cats. I think they're very lazy.
items.whyUz:
'lazy' (dangasa) — SALBIY sifat → salbiy qolip.
Aksi: hard-working (mehnatkash).

items.question: Do you like horses?
items.answer: Yes, I love horses. They're very clever animals.
items.whyUz:
'clever' (aqlli) — IJOBIY sifat → ijobiy qolip.
'clever' va 'intelligent' deyarli bir xil ma'noda.

items.question: Do you like lions?
items.answer: No, I hate lions. I think they're very scary.
items.whyUz:
'scary' (qo'rqinchli) — SALBIY sifat → salbiy qolip.
'scary' = qo'rqitadigan; 'scared' = qo'rqqan. Aralashtirmang.

groups.explanationUz: Fe'lga -er qo'shilsa, o'sha ishni qiladigan shaxs/jonzot chiqadi.
Otga -y qo'shilsa 'shu narsaga to'la/shundan iborat' ma'nosi chiqadi.

patterns.exampleEn: Where do green turtles live? How much do they weigh?
patterns.exampleUz: Yashil toshbaqalar qayerda yashaydi? Ular qancha og'irlikda?
patterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bilan savolda DO/DOES shart.

patterns.formula: What/Why + HAVE + ega + GOT?  ('do' KERAK EMAS)
patterns.exampleEn: What have they got? Why have they got big eyes?
patterns.exampleUz: Ularda nima bor? Nega ularning katta ko'zi bor?
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' o'zi yordamchi fe'l vazifasini bajaradi.

patterns.exampleEn: They have got a shell to protect them. They have got big eyes to help them see well.
patterns.exampleUz: Ularning himoya qiladigan qobig'i bor. Yaxshi ko'rish uchun katta ko'zi bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — nima uchun kerakligini bildiradi.
'help somebody DO' — 'to' YO'Q: help them SEE.

patterns.formula: Do you like + hayvon? — Yes, I love ... / No, I hate ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Do you like dogs? — Yes, I love dogs. They're very friendly animals.
patterns.exampleUz: Itlarni yoqtirasizmi? — Ha, men itlarni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Ular juda do'stona hayvonlar.
patterns.explanationUz: Ijobiy javob: Yes + LOVE. Salbiy javob: No + HATE.
'I think' — o'z fikrini bildirish. 'that' tushirilishi mumkin.

patterns.formula: They spend most of their time + joy/ish.
patterns.exampleEn: They spend most of their time in the sea.
patterns.explanationUz: 'spend time' = vaqt o'tkazmoq. 'most of' = ko'p qismi.
